arguments.literal: Artifact presence, file count, operation count, test count or repository reachability proves no evaluation coverage.
P6

Every material evaluation identifies semantic and decision authority. Every material operation also identifies its existing construction, transformation, admission, publication or mutation authority. A frame set with broad observational reach, an unresolved decision owner or an effectful path without operation authority is not closed.
P6
Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.

Authority takes the kinds frame-set authority, semantic authority, evaluation authority, operation authority and decision authority; actor identity (the human, agent, tool or process performing the work) is an identity and not an authority. These may coincide in a lawful case and never collapse by default. Human authority may act directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy where the governing identity and authority law permits it; proxy identity and human-authority identity stay distinct.
P6, P3

Changed material inputs or a declared revising observation invalidate the affected result before reliance, preserving the predecessor and any demonstrably independent surviving results; a changed basis invalidates likewise.
Return A Closed Result names inputs and observation; TICKET judgment continuity names basis.
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.

A project operates under REFERENCE_FRAME when: 1 human authority has declared the governed workspace, outcome, evaluation inventory and frame set; 2 every active frame is finite, evaluation-bound, basis-bound, authority-safe and usable inside its actor capability envelope; 3 frame results preserve semantic, evidence, inference and decision distinctions; 4 cross-frame conjunction, translation or composition exists only where a material evaluation requires it; 5 workspace coverage maps every known material evaluation and interaction to a capable frame or an explicit residual; 6 operational full coverage is stated relative to its exact tuple; 7 topology, capability, evidence and historical failures can trigger frame revision or recharting; and 8 no executable frame machinery, global context, universal completeness or domain authority is inferred from adopting the member.
P0 to P6

Several frames may evaluate the same subject through separate activations and return closed results. They may overlap in subject, manifold or evidence sources; neither evaluation consumes or influences the other's unclosed working result. This serves assurance independence, different evidence altitudes and distinct failure perspectives.
P6

A composite over several results declares its conjunction; the member it reports is chosen by that declared rule; every known failure and uncovered obligation survives the join and is carried with the composite; no universal order among the non-satisfied members exists.
Later counterevidence arrives.
Every dependent verdict is invalidated until the claim-evidence relation is requalified.

The audit applies cross-cutting lenses to the inventory (outcome and capability; identity and authority; lifecycle and temporal behaviour; topology and interaction seams; transport and representation; evidence and proof; change, failure, recovery and rollback; historical regression; actor capability and context fit). These are lenses: they become frames only when separately instantiated as bounded evaluation families.
P2

Coverage is evaluated against the tuple Coverage(W, G, B, E, S, T): the workspace W, the governed outcome G, the exact basis B, the known evaluation inventory E, the declared frame set S and the time or immutable checkpoint T of the claim. Changing any material member may invalidate the coverage result.
P3, P6

The ledger holds at least, for each evaluation: evaluation (the exact question or predicate); provenance (the source establishing materiality); subject and basis (the exact workspace coordinate); selected frames (the frames capable of evaluating it); actor envelope (the competence and context required); semantic authority (the owner of the evaluated meaning); operation authority (the existing owner grant where the evaluation performs a construction, transformation, admission, publication or mutation; otherwise none); decision authority (the owner of the disposition); evidence (the required observations and their provenance); dependencies (material frame or seam relations); status (the coverage disposition); residual (uncertainty, exclusion or re-entry condition).
P4b, P6
The baseline coverage statuses are covered, separately_covered, conditionally_covered, conflicted, uncovered, unknown and excluded_by_authority.
P4b, P6

Coverage stays falsifiable and externally challengeable. Challenge sources include human knowledge outside the current frame set; independent review; historical failures and predecessor systems; mutation, adversarial and counterexample search; live operation and user behaviour; adjacent workspace or domain comparison; and changes in actor capability, law, dependencies or topology. The method requires an explicit residual boundary and never a claim of metaphysical or universal completeness.

A declared decision rule consumes closed frame results. The rule states which results are mandatory; how conflict and indeterminacy are handled; which basis relations must agree; which decision authority owns the conjunction; and whether any result may veto or defer the decision.
P6, P4a

Diagnosis asks, in this order: 1 Was the correct declared frame activated? 2 Were the subject and basis exact? 3 Was the actor inside the capability envelope? 4 Was admissible evidence available? 5 Is a material variable or invariant missing from the frame? 6 Is a required conjunction or translation missing? 7 Is the evaluation family itself wrong or incomplete? 8 Is another frame required? The order prevents every difficult evaluation from creating another frame.
P2
A composite with a known failure or an uncovered required obligation cannot project success; a known failure A and an uncovered obligation B survive every join.

Without an independently established closed-domain completeness predicate, a finite frame set cannot establish the absence of every undiscovered material evaluation by inspecting its own declared inventory. A finite, formally closed domain may support exhaustive coverage relative to that domain and its completeness predicate; the result does not generalise beyond that boundary. Formal incompleteness results motivate this caution; they do not by themselves prove that a particular workspace or frame set is incomplete.
P0 with the open-world premise; P6

Frames may relate as: disjoint (no material variable, coordinate, evidence or result dependency shared for the declared evaluations); overlapping (some material variables, evidence or entities shared); complementary (distinct evaluations jointly inform one decision); alternative (different frames can evaluate the same claim under declared capability or evidence conditions); refinement (one frame resolves a material distinction left aggregated in another); restriction (one frame evaluates a lawful subset of another's domain); translated (values or evidence move through a declared coordinate map); temporally successive (a later frame evaluates a changed basis); composed (several relations form one governed evaluation or action); or governing and subordinate (one frame inherits declared constraints from another where a real authority or decomposition relation exists).
P3

Human authority may declare an initial project frame set from accumulated practice, known failure modes, domain expertise, the outcome's risk and knowledge of the available actors, without reconstructing it from the workspace bottom up. The declaration records: the governed workspace and outcome; the known evaluation inventory; the selected frames and their capability envelopes; intentional overlaps and separately activated checks; known frame dependencies or translations; semantic, evaluation, operation where material, decision and acceptance authority; known exclusions and residual uncertainty; and the conditions for revision.
P6, P2

For the known material evaluations E(W, G) of workspace W and governed outcome G, a selected frame set S meets the baseline coverage constraint when, for every evaluation e in E(W, G), there is a frame F in S and an available actor a inside F's capability envelope K_F such that F with a is capable of e. Selection also weighs actor context and competence; evaluation risk and consequence; acquisition and reasoning cost; evidence availability; useful independently activated overlap; translation and reconciliation cost; historical blind spots; and reversibility. No optimisation algorithm is prescribed. Human authority may accept a non-minimal set where its added cost buys material risk reduction or better actor fit.

Human authority may require independently activated frame coverage for evaluations whose failure has high consequence, weak observability, strong confirmation bias or a history of local proof masking. Such coverage uses a separately activated evaluation relation and declares any additional assurance-independence conditions. A persona label alone establishes neither relation.
P6

Coverage includes known success, refusal, boundary, integration, recovery, reconstruction and competing-path cases where they are material. Historical failures stay first-class coverage inputs until a declared frame detects or excludes their recurrence.
P4b, P5
Human selection is a lawful source of method structure. It proves neither that the selected set is complete nor that the frames hold authority over the subject relations they inspect.
Whether two activations of one actor family are independent for a semantic judgment is a policy the governing basis states for the claim.
Where no policy is stated, the default is that they are not independent.

The coverage evaluator derives the known evaluation inventory from every material available source, including where applicable: goals, intent, product definition, requirements and accepted method; accepted design, its ontology, identities, lifecycles, authorities and algorithms; implementation capabilities and externally observable behaviour; operational, release, security, safety and governance obligations; dependencies and interaction seams; evidence, tests, scenarios, qualification and acceptance claims; historical tickets, check-ins, commentary, post-mortems, incidents and rejected candidates; days-long loops, resets, repeated repairs and discovered rival paths; known agent capability limits and prior invisible violations; and applicable external law, contracts or standards. The inventory records provenance and materiality.
P2, P6
A compression is lawful only when it preserves the material distinctions and failure detections the evaluation needs.

A lens is a reusable family of questions applied across a frame configuration; it becomes a frame only when instantiated with a bounded evaluation, basis, material manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra and capability envelope.
P2

Every mandatory constraint is satisfied with valid applicable evidence. Common agreement cannot discard a constraint or a material counterexample that only one contributor found. A missing, wrong-subject, conflicted or indeterminate mandatory result stays unresolved under the declared rule; aggregate green status cannot replace it.
P4b, P5

Evaluation-row coverage is insufficient when two covered relations interact in a way capable of changing the governed outcome. Every material interaction is covered by one frame, a declared conjunction, a translation or a material composition evaluation.
P4a, P2
Every material revision changes frame identity or revision coordinates and states which prior activations, results and coverage claims require reevaluation.
P3, P4b

The frame and the functions over it remain distinct. An application may realise the seven relations declare, activate, evaluate, conjoin, translate, audit_coverage and revise in any conforming form; the signatures describe relations, not callable software interfaces. declare is section 4; activate, evaluate and the closed result are ACTIVATION sections 1 to 3 and 7; conjoin and translate are section 6; audit_coverage is section 8; revise is section 10. EVALUATION section 7 qualifies each.

The minimal frame-set declaration is headed 'Frame Set: <stable local identity>' and has the sections: Governed Workspace And Outcome (workspace, outcome, basis, and time); Human Authority (declaration and acceptance authority); Evaluation Inventory (known material evaluations and provenance); Selected Frames (frame identities, revisions, and capability envelopes); Coverage Rationale (mapping from evaluations to capable frames); Intentional Overlap (separately activated checks, assurance-independence conditions, or alternative capability fit); Conjunction And Translation (only the cross-frame relations required by evaluations); Residual Uncertainty (uncovered, unknown, conditional, or excluded evaluations); Revision Triggers (history, topology, capability, evidence, or outcome changes).

These observations trigger frame diagnosis: a competent actor repeatedly cannot see a known material violation; a local repair creates or duplicates another authority path; work repeatedly resets after apparently valid local completion; long implementation loops produce no stable closure; proof passes while the claimed outcome stays unbound; a material failure is visible only after broad integration; reviewers repeatedly expand context without reaching a decidable question; two actors use the same frame name but evaluate different material relations; or a topology mutation leaves prior verdicts apparently current.
P4b, P5
The method does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
No relation is the default universal frame topology. A project declares only the relations its evaluations and coverage claims need.
No universal quota, ticket count, actor count or accounting carrier follows from the cost rule.
An obligation with no route to the selected outcome is unjustified.

One valid frame-set declaration and coverage result establishes only the declare and evaluated audit_coverage population; it proves activation, evaluation, conjunction, translation, revision, result consumption and material composition by no implication. Qualification may be staged, and every verdict states the exact functions, frame revisions, actor envelopes, basis classes, result branches and evidence populations evaluated; an unevaluated function or branch stays open rather than inheriting a whole-method verdict. Prior exemplar frame sets may serve as optional comparison evidence after freeze; they are not mandatory target answers unless the governing basis requires equivalence.
P6

A frame set has operational full coverage for its declared tuple when: 1 every known material evaluation is covered by at least one capable frame; 2 every material interaction has a declared evaluation, conjunction, translation or composition relation; 3 every evaluation has semantic and decision authority, and every material operation has its inherited operation authority; 4 every mandatory claim has an admissible evidence path and a refusal path; 5 the required independently activated overlaps and assurance-independence conditions are present; 6 no unresolved frame-result conflict is hidden by aggregation; 7 excluded evaluations cite their governing authority; and 8 uncovered and unknown residuals are explicit and compatible with the claim. Operational full coverage is relative to its tuple. It is not a claim that no undiscovered evaluation exists.
P6; P0 with the open-world premise
A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation they serve.
Standing: independent. Identical capacity serves opposite purposes.

workspace and governed outcome + accumulated practice and historical failures + available actor capabilities + human judgment -> declared frame set -> bounded evaluations -> conjunction or translation where required -> coverage ledger and residual uncertainty -> empirical frame-set revision.
P6, P2

Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and effective reasoning complexity introduced; an obligation, distinction, carrier or document is justified when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space pays for the concepts, joins, exceptions and states an actor must hold to decide.

A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy whose grant names its scope and exclusions; a proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

The qualification population is every function and failure relation the method claims, each with required representative observations: declare (a frame set derived from workspace, outcome, practices, envelopes, inventory, authority and residual boundary; missing authority or evaluation basis refuses); activate (exact subject, basis and capable actor succeed; stale, ambiguous, topology-mismatched, unauthorised and capability-incompatible activations refuse or return closed pressure); evaluate (representative members of all five results; sensitivity and stability); conjoin (compatible results decide; conflict, basis mismatch, mandatory indeterminacy and veto return conflict, indeterminate or refusal without flattening meaning); translate (preserved coordinates and provenance; explicit loss; mismatch refuses); audit_coverage (evaluation, interaction, authority, failure, capability and independence coverage map to frames or residuals; counts cannot close coverage); revise (failure, mutation, evidence and capability change produce the delta and name every reevaluation); result consumption (a consumer uses one closed result without hidden context; insufficient output fails reconstructability); material composition (a case requiring it declares composition, order, closure, failure and authority conservation; one not requiring it stays uncomposed).
P6
A read-only evaluation declares no operation authority; an effectful evaluation inherits the exact operation grant from its existing owner, and the frame does not create that grant.
P6

An out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible result causes one of: supply the missing admissible evidence; select another actor inside the frame's capability envelope; activate another existing frame; refine or extend a frame declaration; revise the frame set (REFERENCE_FRAME section 10); change the evaluation; or re-enter the governing product or method relation. The disposition follows the cause; a difficult evaluation alone does not prove that another frame is required.
P5, P2

A revision may: clarify activation or evidence acquisition; change the capability envelope; add or remove a material relation; split an overloaded frame; merge duplicative frames where capability and authority stay sound; add intentional overlap; add or revise a conjunction or translation; retire a frame whose evaluation family is no longer material; or revise the project evaluation inventory.
P4b

Every known relation whose lawful change can alter the evaluation result, the validity of the basis, the sufficiency of evidence, operation authority or decision authority appears in the frame or enters through a declared authoritative input. Omitting a material relation makes the frame insufficient. The law does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
P2; P0 with the open-world premise

Every result binds its exact subject, basis, coordinates and evidence scope. A stale, advanced, ambiguous or mismatched basis returns invalid_basis or requires reactivation. Apparent equality never substitutes for declared coordinate equality.
P3, P1

Frames may relate through disjointness, overlap, refinement, restriction, translation, temporal succession, composition or governance. Parent and child relations apply only where explicitly declared. Functional decomposition, authority precedence, frame configuration, subject topology and evaluation dependency are distinct relation structures; a consumer may align them where the subject warrants it and may not silently treat them as one hierarchy.
P3, P1

An activated frame declares the topology changes capable of invalidating its coordinates or its materiality judgment. A detected material topology mutation causes reevaluation, frame revision or recharting before the previous result is reused.
P3, P4b

Coverage and evaluation results retain known uncertainty. Unresolved relations, uncovered evaluations, contested evidence and unknown capability stay explicit. Absence of a recorded counterexample is not evidence of universal completeness.
P4b, P6; open-world premise

A frame compresses accumulated practice when its declaration preserves the material distinctions and failure detections its evaluation family requires while fitting its capability envelope. Compression does not require a unique smallest frame. Intentional overlap is retained where it supplies independently activated evaluation, different capability fit, different evidence altitude or useful fault detection. Frames are merged only when the merged frame preserves evaluation meaning, authority, capability fit and proportional reasoning cost.
P2, P0

These considerations create no universal resource ledger, benchmark, budget or measurement gate. A resource control applies only through an explicitly selected frame and its owning applicability and work scope; ACTIVATION section 6 is that selection where capability fit or a cost claim is the governed question. Frame selection cannot waive another applicable semantic, authority, evidence or independence constraint.
P2, P6

Frame disjointness is structural; evaluation independence is procedural; assurance independence is claim-relative and stated by the governing assurance law (EVALUATION section 3). Disjoint frames need not be independently evaluated; independently activated evaluations need not be disjoint; and the unqualified word independent establishes none of the three.
P6, P1
For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

frame_indexes.scope: Derive a coverage ledger from an evaluation inventory with the seven statuses, apply the diagnostic order to a missing-frame signal, and select a revision action: the coverage tuple, inventory, dimensions, ledger fields, interaction, authority, failure and high-risk coverage, operational full coverage and its completeness boundary, the signals, the eight diagnostic questions, the revision actions, the frame relations and the conjunction rule that decides conflicted rows, and the frame-set declaration they revise. Selected for the F-01 usability case, task B.
